skills.description: Smash a radiant arc for 300% Attack and knock enemies back. A hit heals 35% Attack. Answer adds 50% Attack as damage and another 60% Attack of healing.
An orbiting spirit sword tears through every enemy within 4m as you move. Opening hit plus four pulses; 310% Attack total. Slows enemies; Answer adds knockback.
Dash up to 5m in your movement direction, then run 80% faster for 4s. Leaves a slowing electric wake. Press once; no ground click.
Your sword burns with green spirit energy for 6s: +45% basic damage and +30% attack speed. Guard one frontal blow by 65% for 2s to earn Answer.
Instant lightning slash. Deals 180% Attack in a broad arc and opens enemies for +25% basic damage for 4s. Cast while moving; no target needed.
Erupt a 4s fire field at your feet. Burns nearby enemies for 50% Attack every half second and slows them 25%. Take 25% less damage inside.

quests.title: Briar at the Gate
quests.description: Follow the north road to Briarwood Verge. Keep the young mosslings in front of your blade, collect three moss shards, and return to Elric. Your reward and the hunt gold can buy a better sword from Mara. Other hunts need no quest.

quests.title: A Heart Beneath the Roots
quests.description: Oren has heard amber roots breaking the earth beyond Old Pine Hollow. Follow the side trail and look for the scar yourself. Prepare layered armor, a tempered blade and tonics before striking it. Collapse the Briarwake, then return to Oren for one piece of Wakeglass. The remaining defenders do not vanish when it falls.

quests.title: A Steadier Edge
quests.description: Speak with Smith Oren. Improve any piece of equipment, then report to him.

quests.title: Heart of the Rift
quests.description: Defeat the Rift Sentinel in the southern basin and return to Vela.

quests.title: Shattered Web
quests.description: The eastern glass nest is spreading toward the outpost. Cut down four Glass Spiders and return to Vela.

quests.title: Through the Veil
quests.description: Cross the gate north of Briar Crossing and drive Ember Hounds from Scout Vela's outpost.

quests.title: A Place on the Road
quests.description: Meet Mara and learn where travelers prepare for the March.
